description: This file contains functions related to firmware upgrade and management for Linksys devices, including determining the target firmware partition, performing upgrades, and copying configuration files.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the target firmware partition (kernel or rootfs) based on current boot environment and UBI partition info.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs the platform-specific firmware upgrade process, choosing partitions based on magic numbers, and executing upgrade commands.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_linksys
methods.description: Copies the backup configuration file to a temporary location and synchronizes.
